newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian BASF Antwerp sees partial margins recovery.
newsitem.headline: Belgian BASF Antwerp sees partial margins recovery.

text.p: ANTWERP, Belgium (Reuter) April 2 - Belgian chemical company BASF Antwerpen NV, the largest European production unit of Germany's BASF group, said on Wednesday selling prices had shown a rising trend since the start of 1997 while sales rose by 21 percent to 13.9 billion Belgian francs in the first two months.
"Prices have not yet reached the level required to (offset high raw materials costs fully)," management board chairman Antoon Dieusaert told a news conference.
He said prospects for the year as a whole were good thanks to the introduction of a number of new products and capacity increases completed recently.
